author: Cezbla
body:
Hello avicus people I was thinking a lot today from my last post I saw how everyone was hating on the map devs  and saying they don't care about game play bla bla bla, Para responded pretty much saying he gets caught up in all the traffic. So I thought avicus should add a new rank Map reviewer A map reviewer has no perks no prefix all they do is get asked to join someone's server and see the map and rate it, there should be a game play reviewer and the good looking part reviewer so it is even, once both get on the server and accept the map to its fullest potential then they send it to the map dev's para or evo check the maps one last time and add it, Some map reviewer's need to know YAML to help the mapdev's


You might ask this could go bad? or people will abuse there power, that's why there are mapdev's I think the map dev's should be able to hire these people... they know who the good builder's are and who wont abuse... maybe putting more work on there hands may be a bad thing but on the other hand they get some help.

Best regards, Cez

I'll +1 for now ;)

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Not really necessary, we aren't exactly forced to look at player maps that are in process. It should work like this:
-Player decides to build map.
-Player uses their own creativity to make a map, doesn't matter if it's good or bad.
-Player submits the map to the forums.
-Feedback is given.
